function.name: LOAD_BDF
function.abstract: It recovers of disk any type of BDF font

description.p: This function recovers any type of letter of two colours of disk, in format BDF (Bitmap Distribution Format) of Adobe. This types of letter do not include information of colour: each pixel can be transparent or opaque. By default, the non-transparent pixels will draw with the white colour when you use this font. However, it is possible to select any other colour using the function .
LOAD_BDF returns an entire number that identifies to the font on memory. It can be used this code to write text with functions like .

function.note: It is possible to find fonts in format BDF on Internet, and programs to edit. It is a simple format based on ASCII text. The specifications are on .
